scripts.build: if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- mix compile --warnings-as-errors; else echo 'skipping @ogm/voice-host build (mise unavailable)'; fi
scripts.typecheck: if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- mix compile --warnings-as-errors; else echo 'skipping @ogm/voice-host typecheck (mise unavailable)'; fi
scripts.test: if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- mix test; else echo 'skipping @ogm/voice-host test (mise unavailable)'; fi
scripts.lint: if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- mix format --check-formatted; else echo 'skipping @ogm/voice-host lint (mise unavailable)'; fi
